name: Frigorific-Shoal
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws a binary sunset, patient as erosion itself.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the buried megastructure left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
